issue.title: Deleting a project leaves orphan tasks
issue.body: Deleting a project must delete its tasks, but task rows remain with a missing project.

candidates.title: Project deletion leaves task rows
candidates.body: Task rows survive deleting their parent project and refer to a missing parent.

candidates.title: Cannot create a task
candidates.body: A foreign-key check rejects creation with a nonexistent project.
